svg.title: Suminagashi: four weeks of contributions as floating ink
svg.desc: Each day from 04 October to 31 October 2026 falls into a bath of water as a drop of ink, wider for a busier day: 556 contributions on 28 days.
svg.text: A drop for every day of the last four weeks; a busier day, a wider ring.
OCT 04 – OCT 31 · 556 CONTRIBUTIONS ON 28 OF 28 DAYS · BUSIEST OCT 19 (114), IN VERMILION
